# mtncloud_price (Data Source)

Master tenant only: customer (sub-tenant) logins get 403 from the API it uses. Looks up a price by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_price" "resource_price" {
  name = "resourceprice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud price

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) The code of the MTN Cloud price
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
